notes.title: Otherwar - My new game
notes.content:
After 2 years of hard work I'm pleased to announce my second Steam game.
Now I've teamed up with 2 other developers and we will release Otherwar as kantal collective.

OTHERWAR is an action tower defense game. 
Take control of an angel and defend heaven from the satanic armies. 

[list]
[*]Carefully crafted pixelart
[*]3 main areas
[*]16 monsters
[*]9 towers
[*]Active character to play with
[*]Ambient OST
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1526870/Otherwar/
